finalReading.passage: When Mei first joined the painting club, she could draw only simple shapes and often felt shy about her work. Instead of giving up, she practised a little every day and asked her teacher whenever she was unsure. By the end of the year, one of her ink paintings was chosen for the school exhibition, and she felt proud of how far her daily effort had taken her.

questions.q: What did Mei do instead of giving up?
options: She practised daily and asked her teacher when unsure.
She left the painting club at once.
questions.explanation: 原文说她每天练习并在不确定时请教老师,转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Mei feel at the end of the year?
options: Proud of what her daily effort had achieved.
Sorry that she had started painting.
questions.explanation: 末句说她为每日努力的成果感到自豪(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
